initial_edit_prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing, precise editorial redesign of an existing infographic.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Redesign it substantially as one polished square Spanish social carousel card, 1:1. Preserve the brand Herramientas Rentables and the mathematical meaning, but improve professional hierarchy, balance and mobile legibility. Single finished flat graphic, no mockup or perspective. Use the same coherent design system across all five cards: deep forest #132a24, warm ivory #fbfaf5, lime #dcff68, mint #dcebe4; clean geometric sans-serif akin Manrope/Inter, tabular digits, meticulous spacing, generous safe margins, crisp type, excellent contrast. The logo is a simple lime square with HR and brand name. Main headline is bold, main numbers very large, body text readable on a phone; footer at least 30 px at 1080 px scale. Premium financial editorial aesthetic, restrained fine rules, meaningful simple geometric data visualization. No photos, stock images, people, fake app UI, metallic/glossy effects, watermarks, decorative coins, random icons, extra prose, extra figures, QR codes or fake clickable buttons. All supplied Spanish copy must be exact, with accents, periods in CLP thousands and no invented claims. Entire card must fit comfortably, without overlaps or clipped text.
Header: "HR", "Herramientas Rentables", "1/5". Dark forest background, ivory headline and lime focal numbers. Strong opening with a striking visual typographic hierarchy and an elegant side-by-side numeric comparison linked by a small arrow. Exact headline: "Un proyecto de" / "CLP 300.000." / "¿Cuánto te queda por hora?". Subtitle: "Incluye reuniones, correcciones y costos.". Comparison left: "40 h de trabajo" / "CLP 7.500/h"; comparison right: "48 h + costos" / "CLP 5.625/h". Reading cue: "Desliza para ver la cuenta.". Footnote: "Ejemplo ilustrativo · Antes de impuestos y otros gastos."

corrective_edit.prompt: Precise correction of this existing Spanish carousel image. Keep the square 1254 x 1254 composition, all brand elements, colors, headline, figures, typography and footer. Change only the middle three rows: REMOVE EVERY horizontal bar or progress strip. Replace them with a clean accounting list with generous spacing: left label "Trabajo", right exact value "40 h"; left label "Reuniones", right exact value "5 h"; left label "Correcciones", right exact value "3 h". Plain warm pale mint row backgrounds are fine, but absolutely no quantitative bars, progress meters or chart shapes. Keep the total "48 h en total", result "CLP 6.250 / h", equation "CLP 300.000 / 48 h", note "Antes de costos e impuestos.", footer "Ejemplo ilustrativo en CLP.", brand "Herramientas Rentables", numbering "3/5", and title "Suma el trabajo completo." exactly. Crisp mobile-legible professional infographic. No additional numbers or words. Single final square graphic.
